title: Cost bound for a flattened CNF list
statement: Let $X$ be a list and assign to each element $x$ a CNF over a fixed variable type. If every CNF assigned to an element occurring in $X$ has cost at most $B$, then the cost of the CNF obtained by concatenating these CNFs in list order is at most $|X|B$.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF-valued function on the elements of $X$
Every element of $X$ has assigned CNF cost at most $B$
